europe_now.title: EU Funding and Ukraine Support
europe_now.summary: The European Union has released €6.6 billion to support member states that are providing military equipment to Ukraine. Meanwhile, reports indicate multiple casualties following attacks in Kyiv.

sources.headline: EU releases €6.6 billion for members arming Ukraine as five killed in Kyiv
EU releases €6.6 billion for members arming Ukraine as seven killed in Kyiv

europe_now.title: EU Regulatory Enforcement Against X
europe_now.summary: The European Union has confirmed its commitment to pursue a €120 million regulatory fine against social media platform X. This decision follows ongoing legal challenges and reported support from the United States.

sources.headline: EU vows to pursue €120 million fine on X after US backs Musk's court challenge

top_stories.title: Papal Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived in France for a multi-day state visit, drawing large crowds and leading services in Paris. Events included a major public gathering at the Stade de France and an evening prayer at Notre-Dame Cathedral.

top_stories.title: German Military Service Protests
top_stories.summary: Students across Germany staged widespread strikes to voice opposition to compulsory military service. The demonstrations highlight growing domestic pushback against recent policy adjustments concerning national service.
